resources.string: Warnings when background WhatsApp monitoring may be inactive.
Ongoing notification that keeps WhatsApp/Viber monitoring running while the app is closed.
Consolidated flood monitoring reports ready to send to the WhatsApp group.

Sends the consolidated flood TEXT report automatically into the WhatsApp destination group configured in OKB Bridge (6:00 AM, 6:00 PM, 12:00 AM). It works only inside WhatsApp, only while a report is being sent, and reads nothing else.
